name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.3.0: Add the three large modules (roadmap phase 11); Reach every GPIO, and let zero_label mean what it says.
changelog.v2.2.0: Add the six small modules (roadmap phase 10); Count the new module sections as loaded.
changelog.v2.1.0: Put the modules behind their own list and complete the three shipped ones; Expose the air-quality screen toggle and label the Modules footer.
changelog.v2.0.3: Keep the roster's owning radio across a restart; Keep the node roster across syncs and name userless nodes.
changelog.v2.0.0: Read breaking-change footers into the store changelog.
